The '''Advanced combat implant''' was an experimental piece of technology, designed to make computer data available to the user. This implant contained weapon specifications, and advanced usage techniques for all known weaponry in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and associated allies.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have the implant feat at level 3.
